kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

lines.say: Worked all day? This one's for you.
It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late,
lines.big: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late,

lines.say: to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep. Psalm one twenty seven, verse two.
lines.big: to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

lines.say: Staying up late worrying won't add a thing. He gives his beloved sleep.
lines.big: Staying up late worrying won't add a thing. He gives his beloved sleep.

lines.say: Lord, I'm putting the work down. Give me the sleep you promised. In Jesus' name, amen.
